source.name: BINA Model Health Checklist (contract example, not a published standard)

rules.fix_hint_en: Delete one element of each duplicate pair after checking which one is tagged or hosted.
rules.fix_hint_ms: Padam satu elemen bagi setiap pasangan bertindih selepas menyemak yang mana bertag atau dihos.

rules.fix_hint_en: Fix the largest warning groups first; lookup(kind:'knowledge') has fix notes per warning.
rules.fix_hint_ms: Baiki kumpulan amaran terbesar dahulu; lookup(kind:'knowledge') ada nota pembaikan bagi setiap amaran.

rules.fix_hint_en: Place the room in a plan view or delete it from the room schedule.
rules.fix_hint_ms: Letakkan bilik dalam pandangan pelan atau padam daripada jadual bilik.

rules.fix_hint_en: Close the boundary with walls or room separation lines.
rules.fix_hint_ms: Tutup sempadan dengan dinding atau garisan pemisah bilik.

rules.fix_hint_en: Replace imported CAD with linked CAD on its own workset.
rules.fix_hint_ms: Gantikan CAD yang diimport dengan CAD yang dipaut pada workset sendiri.

rules.fix_hint_en: Rebuild in-place elements as loadable families or system types.
rules.fix_hint_ms: Bina semula elemen in-place sebagai famili boleh muat atau jenis sistem.

rules.fix_hint_en: Number the doors, for example with the renumber-by-position playbook.
rules.fix_hint_ms: Nomborkan pintu, contohnya dengan playbook renumber-by-position.

rules.fix_hint_en: Check the door type's Width; a value outside 600-2400 mm is usually a modelling slip.
rules.fix_hint_ms: Semak Width jenis pintu; nilai di luar 600-2400 mm biasanya kesilapan pemodelan.

rules.title_en: Host levels match the structural link
rules.title_ms: Aras hos sepadan dengan pautan struktur
rules.fix_hint_en: Align the host level elevation with the level of the same name in STR_v3.
rules.fix_hint_ms: Selaraskan ketinggian aras hos dengan aras bernama sama dalam STR_v3.
